component.name: Stellarshot
component.summary: See your backups from the panel

description.p: A COSMIC panel applet for Stellarshot, the backup application. One icon shows whether a backup is running, has failed, has fallen overdue, or found damage, and its popup lists when each backup last succeeded, with buttons to open Stellarshot or quit it.
Add it from COSMIC Settings' panel applet list. Closing Stellarshot's window minimizes it to the applet while it is on a panel.
Safer restores and cleaner credentials, and ready for the COSMIC Store.

ul.li: Closing the restore page no longer stops a running cloud backup, and a snapshot dated in the future no longer makes "Keep for N days" forget the others.
A crafted snapshot can no longer write outside the folder being restored into, and opening someone else's repository no longer takes over their folders.
Sign-in tokens are removed with their backup, downloads are private, and closing the window quits when there is nothing to watch.
Scheduled backups and drives work inside a Flatpak, and the panel applet has a store listing of its own.

description.p: A keyring that is locked is asked to unlock.

ul.li: After logging in without typing the login password, a remembered backup password was not found and a new one could not be saved. The keyring's own unlock prompt now appears when a backup is opened.
